description: Diff the SOFTWARE environment between a good run and a bad one, torch / CUDA / NCCL / driver / flash-attn versions, env vars, and flag combinations known to be broken. Feed it `pip freeze`, `nvidia-smi`, `env` output (or the whole job log; it extracts what it needs). Use this when `compare_runs` points at a version change, or when a job breaks after an image rebuild.

badRun.description: The same artifacts from the failing run.

failureLogs.description: Optional: the failure output itself, for fingerprinting.

goodRun.description: Artifacts from the last good run (pip freeze / nvidia-smi / env, or the full log).

name: diff_environments
title: Diff the package/driver environment of two runs
